# Business impact and criticality analysis

## Mission critical functions

The relay supports no mission critical function; analysts need reports within minutes but
field units buffer through an outage [[INT-019.A1]].

## Supported processes and disruption impact

BP-01, relaying field reports, has a low disruption impact and a 24-hour recovery time
requirement, and depends on the analysis enclave [[INT-019.A1]].

## External dependents

No external stakeholder depends on the relay's processes [[INT-019.A1]].

## Reevaluations

At C-2 no process's disruption impact exceeds the low availability impact, so none is
reevaluated [[INT-019.A1]].

## Criticality analysis

The Frame iteration ranked relaying field reports first; the Assess iteration at C-2 kept it
first and narrowed the list to its critical items [[INT-004.A1]].
